claims.claim: NASA manager Jeremy Parsons stated the agency is tracking closer to 6-8 launches for Starship HLS refueling rather than 22.
claims.episode_span: Jeremy Parsons, manager of the Artemis Program, told attendees at the Artemis Acceleration event on October 23 that NASA is not tracking the 22-launch refueling figure discussed by the Aerospace Safety Advisory Panel.
claims.source_title: NASA's Jeremy Parsons (manager of the Artemis Program) denied Aerospace Safety Advisory Panel's 22 launch refueling estimate for Starship HLS
claims.supporting_quote: So, so we were definitely not tracking as high as 22, unless you know, your transfer efficiency and performance wasn't the same. So I would say Elon's answer of 6 to 8 is, is probably more, again, what SpaceX is planning to, but what I will tell you is our propellant transfer demo is really going to be probably the best method we have to really figure out exactly how many we're going to need.

claims.claim: Ukrainian officials confirmed speeds returned above 400 km/h for moving equipment after Starlink and Starshield restrictions.
claims.episode_span: Ukrainian officials confirmed that speeds on both Starlink and Starshield returned to pre-restriction levels, with connections remaining stable above 400 km/h for moving equipment.
claims.source_title: Ukraine says Starshield back to normal after week-long disruption, Elon Musk accuses Kyiv of violating Starlink’s terms
claims.supporting_quote: Ukraine's defence ministry said on Saturday the connection remained stable at over 400 kph.

claims.claim: Elon Musk stated SpaceX closed a terms-of-service loophole after Ukrainian forces used commercial Starlink terminals for offensive drone strikes.
claims.episode_span: Elon Musk stated on October 24 that SpaceX had closed a terms-of-service loophole after Ukrainian forces used commercial Starlink terminals for offensive drone strikes.
claims.source_title: Musk says SpaceX restricted Ukraine's Starlink connection as service restored
claims.supporting_quote: Ukraine military violated Starlink terms of service and used it for offensive drone strikes to kill people. That loophole was closed last week.

claims.claim: Zelenskyy noted the restoration improved frontline logistics and defense against jet-powered Shahed drones.
claims.episode_span: Zelenskyy noted the restoration improved frontline logistics and defense against jet-powered Shahed drones.
